editorial.blurb: Iron Age Glenview serves high-quality Korean BBQ with attentive service and a fun, welcoming atmosphere—perfect for groups ready to grill at the table.
editorial.insiderTip: Go during off-peak hours (late morning/early afternoon) for a less chaotic experience and better service attention; be aware of the two-hour table limit during busy times.

topDishes.note: high-quality meat with tasty side dishes
